page.layout: One printed page (the right-hand page of the opening, page 63) with one main text column; in the right margin a column of short marginal notes beside the text.

main_text.p: quia, vel turpis, vel ἀδύνατος, aut falte difficilis: vel denique detrimento sia ei qui ad nos scribit. vbi satisfacere amici petitioni plaçuerit, poëlicitatio adhibenda erit studij & officij noftri, eiusdem ratiōnes atq; cautelæ adferendæ: quod nimirum res illa, quæ petitur, cum honestate fit, vel utilitate cōiuncta: neque vsque adeò ardua & difficilis: is qui petit, de nobis aut nostris meritis præclarè: ea præditus pietate, doctrina, virtute, vt denegare ei nihil posfimus.

Quod si vero id quod petit amicus improSententia vsurpanda cum impro-banda aut denegandâ petitio.bare, aut non posse nos facere, oftendere voluerimus: iifdem ex locis rationes adferendæ erunt contrariæ: & indicandum gratificari ea in re amico nos non posse: quod sit, aut turpis illa, aut perniciosa, aut minus necessaria: aut difficilis, & impedimenta multa magnaque obiiciantur, quæ à personis, locis, temporibus fumenda. Refellenda quoque argumenta hîc erunt in petitione ab amico adhibita, vel negando, vel exrenuando, vel compensando, & docendum, commodum, verbi gratia, nullum hîc esse: aut non esse tantum, quantum existimetur: aut plura, altera ex parte, damnasecum atque incommoda adferre. Quemadmodum vero sententiæ

page.notes: Marginal note in the right margin, in small italic type, read as: "Sententia vsurpanda cum impro-banda aut denegandâ petitio." Printed lines were partly indistinct; the note's last words are approximate. Printed spelling ("aut", "vt", "sententiæ") kept as seen. The Greek word "ἀδύνατος" in the first line is a reading of the small Greek on the scan and may be imprecise. Some words near the bottom of the text ("damnasecum", "exrenuando", "compensando") are blurred and marked as printed; the page is also marked by show-through and a slight shadow at the left.
